# TIR-CMM

Canonical name: Threat-Informed Response Capability Maturity Model
Canonical website: https://tir-cmm.com
Canonical model version: v1.0, published 24 August 2026
Browser tool and library version: v1.0.0
Export schema version: v1.0
Workbook version: v1.0
Author: Reza Adineh
Parent operating model: UTIOM — https://utiom.de
Detection companion: TID-CMM — https://tid-cmm.com

TIR-CMM asks: You would see it. Could you stop it?

Core purpose:
Measure whether an organisation can act on a detected attack inside the adversary's breakout window, with someone authorised to act, at an acceptable blast radius, and with evidence that the response capability works.

Model structure:
- 8 domains
- 58 sub-capabilities
- 8 x 8 Containment Lattice
- 7 numbered constraint families (R1-R7)
- 8 enforced checks in v1.0, with R5b represented separately
- maturity scores 0-5
- three assessment depths: Pulse, Baseline, Assurance

Headline metrics:
- Validated Response Score (VRS)
- Engineered rate and Proven rate
- Containment Margin = Breakout Time - (MTTD + MTTDecide + MTTC)
- Tempo Ratio
